title: Privometry release manifest v1
description: One edge release on one channel: its version and a download per OS and architecture. Delivered as the payload of a DSSE envelope (payloadType application/vnd.privometry.release+json) signed with a release key. privometry update installs a release only when the signature verifies, the manifest has not expired, the version is newer than the running one, and the download matches the size and SHA-256 here.

expires_at.description: Devices refuse a manifest after this time, so a mirror cannot keep serving an old release forever. The publisher re-signs the manifest before it expires.

size.description: Exact size of the download in bytes.

binaries.description: The executables in the archive, at its top level. Nothing else is extracted.
